An '''electrum spear''' is a [[spear]] of the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] tier, made by smithing a [[diamond spear]] with [[electrum alloy]]. It has Smite IV, the pack's highest Smite on an item.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the diamond item carry over; where both have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Electrum Spear|damage}} damage at an attack speed of 4: the item sets a damage bonus but no attack speed, so it keeps the base speed. It has {{Value|Electrum Spear|durability}} durability.

=== Intrinsics ===
Smite IV, Looting II and [[Warding]] 2. Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into an [[adamant alloy]], not electrum, because electrum shares the netherite item IDs. This makes melting electrum gear a way to turn an [[electrum alloy]] into an adamant alloy.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
{{Uses}}

An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[electrum alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/electrum_spear.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows attack speed 1.18 (real value 4).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/electrum_spear.json}}</ref>
